pdf_page_note: Assigned PDF range is 60–69; these 67 manifest records themselves map to PDF 60–68, including printed page 136 on PDF page 68. No manifest record is assigned to PDF page 69.
method: Compared every candidate with its authoritative source PNG and inspected the complete image plus native-resolution strips of all four edges; enlarged ambiguous marks and the page-130 overlap separately. All 67 source and candidate images decode as RGB; dimensions and raw decoded crop bytes match exactly. No resampling, retouching, or artificial margin exists in the candidates. Temporary inspection panels were not production changes.

conventions.rect: source PNG pixels [left, top, right, bottom], right/bottom exclusive
conventions.proposed_rect: Only a completely source-tested safe replacement; null means no fully safe replacement certified, not permission to retain a failing crop.
conventions.source_limited: True when a complete isolated rectangular crop cannot exclude the observed embedded/overlapping non-example marks while preserving the example. It is not approval or authorization to retouch.
conventions.specks: Isolated scan flecks are distinguished from coherent letters, handwritten figures/circles/arrows, and continuous or dotted foreign lines. The latter are identified specifically below.
